title: 106th Rescue Wing Deployers Return Home
description: B-roll of members of the 106th Rescue Wing Security Forces Squadron being greeted by friends and family at MacArthur Airport on Long Island, N.Y., following a recent deployment to Afghanistan. Includes interviews with Gene Parrington, town of Islip councilman, and representatives from the Sayville American Legion Post. Produced by Tech. Sgt. Eric Miller. Also available in high definition.
